run_random_replay_cli: run the random_replay CLI to replay best actions from prior random search logs
run_replay_actions_from_logs: run replay_actions_from_logs to replay the best action sequence found during random search
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to validate output_dir and replay best random search results
review_main_function: review the main function that parses flags and replays actions from random search logs
test_random_replay_with_env: test the random_replay module by providing an env and output_dir with random_search.json
